title: Lavishly Charred Algerian Dish Bake
description: A charred, shattering, midnight-craving Algerian dish featuring toast, sashimi-cut meat and vegetables, baked to perfection in individual-mini-cocottes.

ingredients.name: boneless lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: preferably with the bone in for extra flavor

ingredients.name: mixed mushrooms
ingredients.notes: such as button, cremini and shiitake

instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper and cumin seeds.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and brown the lamb on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to a plate and set aside.
Add the thinly sliced onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened and lightly caramelized.
Add the mixed mushrooms to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the harissa to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the lamb back to the pan and add the chicken broth.
Cover the pan with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the lamb for 20 minutes, then reduce the heat to 180°C (350°F) and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the meat is tender.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
To assemble the dish, place a slice of the lamb on each toasted bread round, followed by a spoonful of the mushroom mixture and a dollop of harissa.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
